description: This file defines the CrossPlatformInitialize class which manages scripting define symbols for different build targets in Unity, facilitating cross-platform input functionality. It provides methods to enable or disable mobile input and updates compilation symbols accordingly.

classes.name: CrossPlatformInitialize
classes.description: Handles setting and toggling scripting define symbols related to cross-platform input in Unity Editor.

methods.name: CrossPlatformInitialize
methods.description: Static constructor initializes define symbols based on current build target.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables mobile input and shows dialog based on build target.

methods.name: EnableValidate
methods.description: Validates whether mobile input can be enabled based on existing defines.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables mobile input and shows confirmation dialog.

methods.name: DisableValidate
methods.description: Validates whether mobile input can be disabled.

methods.name: SetEnabled
methods.description: Helper method to add or remove a scripting define symbol for specified build target groups.

methods.name: GetDefinesList
methods.description: Retrieves list of scripting define symbols for a given build target group.
